title: Sunset Whistle
description: A wistful whistle-flute topline melody in C major, built from a triangle wave blended with a whisper of breath noise. The melodic phrase slowly rotates through a 4-bar legato arc while vibrato depth, filter brightness, pan position, and delay wash all drift on mutually-prime LFO clocks (7, 13, 17, 24 cycles), so the hook feels alive and never exactly repeats — a romantic beach-sunset hook that blooms over roughly 48 cycles before cycling back.
code:
setcpm(96/4)
stack(
  note("<c5 e5 g5 <a5 f5>>/2")
    .s("triangle")
    .noise(0.06)
    .vib("<5 6>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.6))
    .lpf(sine.slow(17).range(1800, 5500)).resonance(3)
    .attack(0.08).decay(0.3).sustain(0.75).release(0.35)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.25, 0.75))
    .delay("0.5:0.375:0.5").room(0.55)
    .off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.18).pan(0.85))
    .gain(0.82)
)
